assets.alt: 两只手同时指向同一盘中的苹果和梨，加号表示两个对象都包括在内
assets.scene: A simple illustrated educational addition of TWO different objects considered together: one large red apple at left AND one large green pear at right, equally prominent, side by side on the same plate. Above them, two human hands simultaneously gently indicate both fruits, one finger pointing to the apple, the other to the pear, inclusive rather than choosing either. A small clear hand-painted plus symbol BETWEEN the fruits reinforces joining A AND B; it is a visual relation mark, not written language. Both fruits whole and separate, no blending, cutting, juice, exchange, alternatives or other fruit. One single coherent composition about including both objects together.

candidates.alt: 赛跑中其他孩子都已过终点等待，最后一名孩子正在跨过终点线
candidates.scene: Show the FINAL runner finishing AFTER every other runner. A small friendly school race viewed clearly from the side: a wide unlettered white finish line crosses the ground. Four children have already crossed and now stand well beyond the finish line at the right, relaxed, waiting and gently encouraging the one remaining runner. ONE last child at left is just crossing that line, tired but happy. The entire visible track behind this last child is empty. The group has all finished first; this child finishes LAST, closing the sequence. No race winner celebration, no first-place podium, no trophy, no medals, no rankings, no numbers, no ribbon. This should clearly mean 'and finally, the last one finishes', not fastest victory. Compact related scene, all characters and finish line fully visible.
